build_evidence: BUILD-EVIDENCE.md in this directory, append-only and deliberately not hashed by this manifest.

driver.note: D-7 execution HALTS at preflight unless unposable_against_this_freeze is empty AND every mandatory preflight requirement, including a supported strace, succeeds.

m3_t.bounded_claim: For the direct child in this candidate execution, the pidfd used by the launcher was returned through the CLONE_PIDFD facility of the SAME clone3 syscall that created that direct child, rather than being acquired later by pidfd_open() from a numeric PID.
claim_exclusions: the kernel implementation has been proved atomic
any general claim about pidfd behaviour beyond this one execution
any timing-sensitive normal-launch behaviour: M3 runs under a tracer, and its evidence is restricted to the acquisition facts below
m3_t.closure_form: REMOVED by R-2; absence of pidfd_open no longer proves which descriptor clone3 returned

evidence_facts.A: exactly one relevant candidate clone3 direct-child creation
evidence_facts.D: clone3 succeeds and returns the DIRECT_CHILD pid
evidence_facts.E: the tracer directly renders the pidfd produced by that clone3 call
evidence_facts.F: that pidfd equals the pidfd used by the launcher's direct-child lifecycle observation
evidence_facts.G: waitid(P_PIDFD, that_pidfd, ...) reports si_pid == the clone3 return
evidence_facts.H: no pidfd_open(DIRECT_CHILD_PID) acquisition path is observed

m3_t.self_assertion_rejected: no pidfd_acquisition receipt field exists in launcher_spike.c and the rule never reads one

requires: ONE final micro-review of the F-1/F-3 delta before D-7; this freeze is NOT a readiness statement and grants nothing
scope: Execution definition and disposable experiment sources frozen before the first preregistered LAUNCH-EXEC-01 trial. NOT_RUN: no trial has been executed and no case has been posed. D-7 (execution authorisation) is NOT granted.
supersession_reason: closes F-1 and F-3, the current-vocabulary gap the final short independent verification recorded at abe747f. T6's published plan carries parent = sigterm_blocked_sigpipe_ignored, a 31-character driver PARENT_STATES key that the hand-written allowlist had missed, so the generic opaque rule rewrote it in published evidence. Rather than adding that string, the fixed-vocabulary set is now DERIVED FROM THE REGISTRIES: frozen_cases, observations (RULES, dispositions, refusals, signal and errno tables, report and return states, lifecycle and exec constants), checker statuses, the published observation schema, and the driver's SETUPS, PARENT_STATES, POSED_CHECKS and ALL_CHANNELS - the last imported lazily because driver imports evidence. F-3, returned_before_descendant_lifetime, is protected by the same derivation although no plan references it, and was NOT made reachable to test it. F-2 remains a non-defect: A4's 4096-byte argument is data, not symbolic vocabulary, and is still published as an opaque token. The opaque rule still redacts genuine secrets and still preserves digests. No C source byte changed. Earlier freezes and every review record are preserved unchanged.

traced_cases.note: a syscall record is collected ONLY for these cases. R, T, O, P and S cases are never traced, because ptrace notifies the tracer before the real parent and those cases measure the launcher's own waitid classification.

tracer_requirement.fallback: none; the ptrace fallback the definition once promised is withdrawn
tracer_requirement.not_a_block_cause: tracer unavailability is never clone3_unavailable and never a conditional BLOCKED cause
tracer_requirement.on_failure: preflight HALT before the first preregistered case
tracer_requirement.statement: A usable strace >= 5.4 is a mandatory pretrial environment requirement. If strace is absent, older than the floor, or cannot render the trace contract the traced cases depend on, the runner HALTS before the first preregistered case. No ptrace, eBPF, helper-binary or root-requiring fallback exists or may be added for 0.1.

observations (RULES, spike dispositions and refusals, signal and errno tables, report states, return states, lifecycle and exec constants)
published observation schema and normalised role names
driver (SETUPS, PARENT_STATES, POSED_CHECKS, ALL_CHANNELS), imported lazily to avoid the driver -> evidence cycle
vocabulary.not_vocabulary: argv contents, environment values, host paths, captured bytes, tracer text and any high-entropy value remain redactable; A4's 4096-byte argument is still published as <OPAQUE:...>
